thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [P1] Dedicated pool dp-592: node gpu-azb-07 reporting ECC/driver faults; affecting tenant orion-payments-prod. Auto-evac initiated. Root thread ts=1761800000

sam_oncall_ml: acknowledged. I'm on it — paging SRE and Dedicated team. 

ash_sre: @sam_oncall_ml seeing the same in metrics: node gpu-azb-07 showing NVML ECC_UNCORRECTABLE and OOMs during model loads. 502s spiking for orion-payments-prod in us-east-1b.

priya_eng_dedicated: joining. dp-592 capacity is 6 GPUs total, one node down leaves pool at 83% utilization; autoscaler hasn't spun new spot yet because AZ quota. / We should cordon+drain before we get more failures.

jon_platform: what's the customer impact? sla? any sensitive data at risk?

lea_cust_success: Orion Payments (ent: orion-payments-prod) is on Dedicated DP-592 VPC. SLA is 99.9 latency and dedicated throughput. They're seeing ~10% request failures and longer tails; they've started a pager on their side. I've messaged their SREs. No data leak risk — requests failing during inference only.

sam_oncall_ml: mitigation plan: 1) cordon gpu-azb-07, 2) drain pods, prefer to migrate orion-prod replicas to dp-fallback pool (dp-601) with quantized variant, 3) mark node for replacement and order hardware check/replace. Anyone object?

ash_sre: agree. I'll run cordon/drain now. Commands: 

```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-azb-07
kubectl drain node/gpu-azb-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

Also doing a quick run of nvidia-smi and dmesg to capture errors.

priya_eng_dedicated: I'm enabling canary migration to dp-601 for orion-payments-prod: moving 2 replicas to quantized-model:v2q. This reduces memory but slightly increases token latency. Notifying customer.

infra-bot: Notice: aws-spot-interruption-check returned NO for gpu-azb-07; instance termination NOT scheduled. HBA SMART status shows bad sectors flagged.

sam_oncall_ml: that points to hardware fault not spot. ash, please capture GPU serial + driver logs.

ash_sre: pulled logs: 
```
[2026-06-11T14:02:01Z] NVML ECC Error: 0xE1 UNCORRECTABLE
[2026-06-11T14:02:01Z] GPU serial: GPU-SN-78A4C
[2026-06-11T14:02:04Z] Process oom-killer: model-server PID 4123
```
Also `dmesg` shows PCIe link resets.

jen_ops: coordinating with infra replacement team. ETA for physical node swap ~45-60m if spare available in us-east-1b; if not, will reprovision in us-east-1c and re-attach to DP with updated routing.

lea_cust_success: Orion asked for timeline. I'll tell them ~1 hour for replacement and that we routed a subset to dp-601 (quantized) to reduce failures. They want to know if this impacts output quality. Priya, can we add a deterministic flag so they can compare outputs?

priya_eng_dedicated: yes; we can add a header in responses: X-Model-Variant: v2q and enable verbose-debug for a subset of their traffic for regression tracking. We'll limit to 5% traffic.

jon_platform: add fallback policy in console: failure -> dp-601 (v2q) for tenant orion-payments-prod. Also enable trace sampling so we can correlate errors to tokens.

ash_sre: drain in progress; some pods stuck on preStop (LLM KV flush). Manually forcing eviction for 2 stuck replicas. Running: 
```
kubectl delete pod orion-prod-rt-2 --grace-period=30 --force
```

sam_oncall_ml: observed latency tail drop after two replicas moved. Error rate went from 12% -> 3% for orion-prod traffic. Not fully resolved.

infra-bot: New node replacement started: provisioning i4i.16xlarge alt in us-east-1c. Allocation id: alloc-08b3d.

jen_ops: rebalancing routing now, but dp autoscaler will be forced to scale +1 to avoid further pressured nodes.

lea_cust_success: Orion appreciates the quick fallback. They're asking if we can keep v2q for a longer window. They prefer stability > marginal quality.

priya_eng_dedicated: OK to keep 50% traffic on v2q for next 4 hours; we'll keep regression checks.

ash_sre: marking gpu-azb-07 as "failed" in inventory and creating replacement job: ticket INFRA-4729. Attaching logs/artifacts.

sam_oncall_ml: passing to ops for replacement and postmortem. Jen, can you take over for follow-up? I'll remain available for escalation.

jen_ops: taking over. I'll update Jira, ping infra on swap, and supervise node join. ETA now 35m.

jon_platform: set incident tag: dedicated-pool-node-failure, impacted-tenant: orion-payments-prod, mitigation: fallback-to-dp-601 (v2q), node-replaced: pending.

infra-bot: Node gpu-azb-07 removed from pool dp-592 at 2026-06-11T15:10:27Z; replacement gpu-eusc-12 joined dp-592 at 2026-06-11T15:42:10Z. Health checks passed.

jen_ops: replacement complete, rebalancing back some traffic to dp-592. We'll gradually drain dp-601 to normal routing over 20 minutes.

lea_cust_success: told Orion: node replaced, health checks green, we kept some traffic on v2q temporarily; we'll return to normal profile in 30 minutes and follow up with regression report. They said :thumbsup:.

priya_eng_dedicated: post-replace checks: model loads are stable on new node, no ECC errors. Running a 30m stress test with orion's replay.

ash_sre: collecting metrics for postmortem: GPU ECC counts, OOM frequency, pod evictions, latency percentiles. Will draft initial incident timeline.

sam_oncall_ml: closing active paging. Severity downgraded to P2 for postmortem/RCAs. Thanks everyone.

jen_ops: handoff note: will own follow-up and postmortem doc; leaving a runbook entry update to ensure spare capacity in us-east-1b for dp-592.

incident-bot: Incident closed for paging at 1761804200.
